other_conditions: Applicant must own or lease a pond of at least one acre for a minimum of three years
Proposed site should be near a population centre
Preference is given to applicants closer to district headquarters for better monitoring
Applicant near Resource Fisheries Facilities (RFF) must have an active bank account and belong to a functional beneficiary group
Applicants who were selected in 2022‑23 but did not receive grants will be prioritized
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹1,22,680 for SC/ST/women beneficiaries and up to ₹1,07,345 for other beneficiaries, paid in three DBT installments.
